Hero.paragraph: <brand>TECHTIE</brand> specializes in agentic automation: we combine N8N, LangChain and LangFuse with tailored dashboards, CRMs and integrations to turn data and processes into real results. Grow efficiently and generate lasting value.
Hero.stackLabel: We build with the most modern stack:

HowItWorks.heading: Three fronts, one operation
HowItWorks.intro: Agentic automation to organize the operation, Business Intelligence to see it clearly, and artificial intelligence to accelerate it — integrated from the ground up, with N8N, LangChain, LangFuse and a modern end-to-end stack.
HowItWorks.itemClientsDescription: Clients, sales pipeline, deadlines and tasks in one place, with a complete relationship history, account owners and automated notifications via N8N — built around your business process, with Bitrix24 or a custom CRM.
HowItWorks.itemLawsuitsDescription: Automated flows built with N8N, agents built in LangChain and monitored with LangFuse, connecting WhatsApp, forms, spreadsheets and APIs to eliminate manual, repetitive work from the operation.
HowItWorks.itemBiDescription: Tailored dashboards covering sales, operations, productivity and risk, with data handled in PostgreSQL and Supabase, with no spreadsheet exports or external tools to rely on. Decisions based on your own business data.
HowItWorks.itemIndicatorsDescription: Volume by area, channel and stage, risk concentration and workload per owner, to guide staffing, priorities and investment.
HowItWorks.itemRiskDescription: Every event is automatically classified by AI agents built with LangChain — urgent, positive or routine — and summarized in plain language, with end-to-end observability via LangFuse.
HowItWorks.itemAssistantDescription: AI trained on your business context: query data, request summaries and find information in natural language, right inside your system.

About.heading: Technology born from practice, built for any business
About.paragraph1: TechTie was born from the experience of Dr. Bruno Durão, partner at BMD Dap Advocacia, one of the country's largest law firms, after facing firsthand the same problem that slows down most companies: information scattered across spreadsheets, systems that don't talk to each other, and manual processes that drain the team's time. The solution built to fix that became a product — and today TechTie brings that same automation to businesses in any industry.
About.paragraph2: We specialize in agentic automation (N8N, LangChain, LangFuse) and master a full stack to deliver tailored solutions: relational and non-relational databases, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Hostinger, Angular, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter, React Native, Firebase and Bitrix24. Always with a clear view of the operation and decisions based on data, not outdated spreadsheets.
